summary: Shoshone County 10-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, built in 1932 in the St. Joe National Forest and destroyed in 1969; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: 10-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1969; no source describes what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes a trail or current access.

evidence.supports: built 1932 as a 10-foot pole tower with L-4 cab

notes_for_editor: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts agree on 1932 build and 1969 destruction, with hike-in label on the Idaho page. The FFLA list says gone. Caution: a search snippet and a Forest Service Lochsa list row (fs.usda.gov/media/259185, 'butte 15 miles S of Avery', lightning 1924, cupola 1925) describe a different Shoshone County lookout, most likely Monumental Butte; not used here. No staffing or fire history found. Record county Shoshone is correct; record coordinates match the FFLA list.
